Reference image1 is the SELECTED LIVE HERO: use its premium contemporary editorial art direction, Lora-like Cyrillic serif, Inter-like body, warm parchment #F4F0E8, dark forest #2C3B2D, terracotta #C05A3A, restrained sage/mist, hairline rules, generous calm spacing, subtle linen/paper materials. Ignore its small comparison label and do not repeat its hero. Subsequent reference images show CURRENT SECTION CONTENT and any retained interaction/illustration principle; redesign the layout coherently rather than copying their old appearance. Preserve the exact supplied Russian wording. No testimonials, statistics, promises, new features, forms, prices, badges, or invented paragraphs. TARGET SECTION: Путь книги к читателю. Target image1536×920, natural full-width section.

ART DIRECTION:
Deep forest-green publication process section, MUST remain green. Cream serif heading across top, no cramped line breaks. Below, one generous three-column editorial sequence separated by fine muted vertical lines, rather than individual cards.
